defects: Unauthorised non-PO charge: $640.00 delivery and handling line exceeds the $500.00 pass-through limit (clause 6)
rationale: Line 1 matches the PO exactly on price and quantity (6 EACH @ $410.00, all 6 received per GR-7718), so the goods portion is clean. The decisive fact is line 2: contract clause 6.2 permits passing through oversize carrier cost, but clause 6 of the policy also caps any non-PO line at $500.00, and this charge is $640.00 with no buyer authorisation on file. That single unauthorised-surcharge defect gives HOLD_PRICE_VARIANCE at $0.00 (clauses 6, 11.1, 12); the resulting $48.00 tax overstatement is derivative of that same line, not a separate defect.
